If you're using Meta Quest Link (wired or Air Link) for PCVR, consider switching to something else.

**The Problems:**
Meta Link has constant issues with updates, random disconnects and crashes, visual artifacts, and a general lack of maintenance since PCVR users typically buy games on Steam anyway.

**What to Use Instead:**
**Virtual Desktop** (~$25 on Quest Store)
The gold standard for wireless PCVR — and it now supports a wired USB connection too (new in the current beta), so it can replace Quest Link's cable as well. Better customization, reliability, and actively maintained. "It just works."

**Steam Link** (Free)
Valve's official solution with good performance. It now has initial direct wired USB support for Meta Quest in beta, including use without Wi-Fi. This currently requires the Steam Link for Meta Quest beta, SteamVR beta, and Steam Client beta. Will be the native option for the upcoming Steam Frame headset.

**ALVR** (Free, Open Source)
Completely free alternative. Less user-friendly but very capable if you like tinkering.

**Note:** Wireless PCVR doesn't require fast internet - it only needs a good local network. All streaming happens between your PC and headset on your LAN.
